title: Scaffold Write Debug: A Three-Stage Approach to Proof Writing in Introductory Real Analysis
summary: This article describes Scaffold Write Debug, a three-stage instructional approach used in an introductory real analysis course to support students learning mathematical proof. The approach combines guided proof completion, independent proof writing, and the analysis and correction of faulty proofs. The goal is to help students understand proof structure, develop confidence in writing proofs, and become more careful readers of mathematical arguments.
